SELECT 
    t1.makername AS manufacturer,
    t1.modnum AS model,
    t2.irs_score,
    t2.joyprec AS joystick_precision,
    t2.driftres AS drift_resistance,
    t2.trigres AS trigger_resistance,
    t2.hapstr AS haptic_strength
FROM 
    deviceidentity AS t1
JOIN 
    interactionandcontrol AS t2 ON t1.devregistry = t2.interactdevref;
